content.title: Bionomics Strategic Shift with Neuphoria Redomiciliation
content.summary: Bionomics ( (BNOX) ) has issued an update. Neuphoria Therapeutics Inc. has completed its redomiciliation, transferring governance from Bionomics’ organizational documents to Neuphoria’s new Certificate of Incorporation and bylaws. This strategic move positions Neuphoria as the successor issuer to Bionomics, with its shares now registered under the Exchange Act, which may influence its governance structure and shareholder rights.
